# Owned Hearts assets

KayKit PlayingCards: 52 FBX card models, their 52 face PNGs and one shared cardback_A PNG. Kay Lousberg / KayKit, Board Game Bits EXTRA, CC0; source and license are retained in KayKit/README.md. ForestNaturePack contains six existing Color1 models and the shared forest texture; its README records KayKit provenance and CC0 licensing. Sources were copied unchanged from the repository owned asset pool. No chess player or assembly is required.

Barlow Condensed 700 and its existing UI font asset are in Fonts with the original SIL Open Font License. Card face/back and model-material mappings are declared in ../../project-assets.json and imported through the shared project asset generator. Models and textures are unchanged; generated materials use Unity Standard with nonmetallic matte settings.
